en.activation_modifier_tooltip: All three options have the same effect: hold the chosen modifier while adding a stop to select alternatives. Ctrl/Shift/Alt are the default bindings; actual keys follow the named game action. Ordinary clicks keep the base game behavior.

zh_CN.activation_modifier_tooltip: 三项效果相同：按住触发键新增站点才自动选备用，普通点击保持原版行为。Ctrl/Shift/Alt 为默认键位；若修改过对应游戏动作的绑定，请使用修改后的按键。
